Clinical assessment within the corpus is notably illustrated through the evaluation of patient comorbidity indices, specifically the [[charlson-score|Charlson Score]]. In a review of this assessment methodology, [[regionshospital-nordjylland|Regionshospital Nordjylland]] identified a significant discrepancy regarding the baseline patient group. The hospital found that none of the patients categorized in the "score 0" population for the Charlson Score actually fulfilled the criteria for this classification, as every patient in that group had a high age [^src1]. This single documented instance highlights the complexities and potential misclassifications inherent in applying standardized clinical assessment tools to specific patient demographics, demonstrating that strict adherence to scoring criteria can be confounded by variables like age.

## Claims
- Regionshospital Nordjylland har identificeret, at ingen af patienterne i 'score 0'-populationen for Charlson-score faktisk opfylder kriterierne, idet de alle har høj alder [^src1] (regionshospital-nordjylland, charlson-score)
